content.text:
**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement contains no minimum purchase commitment or volume restriction on Clear Capital:

- **§ 1(a)** engages RadialSpark "on a task by task basis," with scope defined only through mutually agreed Statements of Work.
- **§ 3(a)** compensates the Contractor "on a time and materials" basis plus actual out-of-pocket expenses — i.e., fees for ordered services only.
- Full-text searches for *minimum*, *commit*, *shortfall*, *take or pay*, *volume*, *retainer*, and *guarantee* returned no purchase-commitment or usage-cap language anywhere in the document.
- **§ 6(a)** additionally lets either party terminate for convenience on fifteen days' notice whenever no Statement of Work is outstanding, so there is no residual take-or-pay exposure.

This sits at the **preferred** position, not merely the fallback, so no edit is warranted. One forward-looking note recorded in the rationale rather than flagged as a deviation: because commercial terms are pushed into Statements of Work, any future SOW that introduces committed hours, a monthly retainer, or minimum spend should be reviewed against this rule at that time.
